questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to house or provide space for'?
explanation: Accommodate is correct - A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-E. Accommodate has double C and double M. It means to have room for.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability to move well'?
explanation: Agility is correct - A-G-I-L-I-T-Y. Agility means the ability to move quickly and easily.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make separate'?
explanation: Separate is correct - S-E-P-A-R-A-T-E. Separate means to set apart. Remember: there is a rat in separate.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'truly or very much'?
explanation: Definitely is correct - D-E-F-I-N-I-T-E-L-Y. Definitely means without doubt.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not happening often'?
explanation: Occasionally is correct - O-C-C-A-S-I-O-N-A-L-L-Y. Occasionally means from time to time. Double C and double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a room in a school'?
explanation: Classroom is correct - C-L-A-S-S-R-O-O-M. A classroom is a room where lessons take place. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very important or necessary'?
explanation: Necessary is correct - N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y. Necessary means required or essential. One C, double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'something happening at the same time'?
explanation: Simultaneous is correct - S-I-M-U-L-T-A-N-E-O-U-S. Simultaneous means happening at the same time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a government rule'?
explanation: Government is correct - G-O-V-E-R-N-M-E-N-T. Government is the group of people who control a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to allow or make possible'?
explanation: Privilege is correct - P-R-I-V-I-L-E-G-E. Privilege means a special advantage or right.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a written piece submitted for grading'?
explanation: Assignment is correct - A-S-S-I-G-N-M-E-N-T. Assignment is a task or piece of work given to someone. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to do with language and grammar'?
explanation: Grammatical is correct - G-R-A-M-M-A-T-I-C-A-L. Grammatical means relating to grammar. Double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the act of going on vacation'?
explanation: Travelling is correct - T-R-A-V-E-L-L-I-N-G. Travelling means going on a journey. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to feel unsure about'?
explanation: Doubt is correct - D-O-U-B-T. The B is silent. Doubt means to be uncertain about something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'happening often'?
explanation: Frequently is correct - F-R-E-Q-U-E-N-T-L-Y. Frequently means at short intervals or often.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not able to be believed'?
explanation: Unbelievable is correct - U-N-B-E-L-I-E-V-A-B-L-E. Unbelievable means impossible to believe or amazing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an event that surprises everyone'?
explanation: Phenomenon is correct - P-H-E-N-O-M-E-N-O-N. A phenomenon is a remarkable or extraordinary occurrence.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'related to the environment'?
explanation: Environmental is correct - E-N-V-I-R-O-N-M-E-N-T-A-L. Environmental means relating to the natural world.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not logical or sensible'?
explanation: Irrational is correct - I-R-R-A-T-I-O-N-A-L. Irrational means not based on reason. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'full of talent'?
explanation: Talented is correct - T-A-L-E-N-T-E-D. Talented means having a natural skill or ability.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'something done regularly'?
explanation: Routine is correct - R-O-U-T-I-N-E. A routine is a set of actions done regularly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very good looks'?
explanation: Beautiful is correct - B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L. Beautiful means pleasing to the senses.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not sure what to do'?
explanation: Confused is correct - C-O-N-F-U-S-E-D. Confused means unable to think clearly or uncertain.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'happening without preparation'?
explanation: Spontaneous is correct - S-P-O-N-T-A-N-E-O-U-S. Spontaneous means done without planning or forethought.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to get rid of'?
explanation: Eliminate is correct - E-L-I-M-I-N-A-T-E. Eliminate means to remove or get rid of completely.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'full of life'?
explanation: Exuberant is correct - E-X-U-B-E-R-A-N-T. Exuberant means very enthusiastic and full of energy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a state of confusion'?
explanation: Mayhem is correct - M-A-Y-H-E-M. Mayhem means a state of confusion and chaos.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not capable of making an error'?
explanation: Infallible is correct - I-N-F-A-L-L-I-B-L-E. Infallible means incapable of being wrong. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'easy to notice'?
explanation: Conspicuous is correct - C-O-N-S-P-I-C-U-O-U-S. Conspicuous means easily seen or noticed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'deep respect and admiration'?
explanation: Reverence is correct - R-E-V-E-R-E-N-C-E. Reverence means deep respect for someone.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a serious crime'?
explanation: Felony is correct - F-E-L-O-N-Y. A felony is a serious criminal offense.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to fail completely'?
explanation: Catastrophe is correct - C-A-T-A-S-T-R-O-P-H-E. A catastrophe is a sudden disaster.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'having to do with sound'?
explanation: Acoustic is correct - A-C-O-U-S-T-I-C. Acoustic means relating to sound or hearing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'extremely noticeable'?
explanation: Pronounced is correct - P-R-O-N-O-U-N-C-E-D. Pronounced means very noticeable or strongly marked.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of ancient objects'?
explanation: Archaeology is correct - A-R-C-H-A-E-O-L-O-G-Y. Archaeology is the study of ancient human history through artifacts.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a speech disorder'?
explanation: Stammer is correct - S-T-A-M-M-E-R. To stammer means to speak with involuntary pauses. Double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'deeply absorbed in something'?
explanation: Engrossed is correct - E-N-G-R-O-S-S-E-D. Engrossed means absorbed or completely occupied. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not following rules'?
explanation: Noncompliant is correct - N-O-N-C-O-M-P-L-I-A-N-T. Noncompliant means not complying with rules or agreements.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to copy someone'?
explanation: Imitate is correct - I-M-I-T-A-T-E. To imitate means to copy the actions or speech of someone.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a form of art using words'?
explanation: Poetry is correct - P-O-E-T-R-Y. Poetry is writing that uses rhythmic language to express ideas.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a long journey by water'?
explanation: Voyage is correct - V-O-Y-A-G-E. A voyage is a long journey by sea or air.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to increase in amount'?
explanation: Multiply is correct - M-U-L-T-I-P-L-Y. To multiply means to increase in number or quantity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a written summary of events'?
explanation: Chronicle is correct - C-H-R-O-N-I-C-L-E. A chronicle is a factual record of events in chronological order.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not expected'?
explanation: Surprise is correct - S-U-R-P-R-I-S-E. Surprise means an unexpected event or feeling of astonishment.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very far away'?
explanation: Distant is correct - D-I-S-T-A-N-T. Distant means far away in space or time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'unable to be seen through'?
explanation: Opaque is correct - O-P-A-Q-U-E. Opaque means not transparent or clear.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make something better'?
explanation: Enhance is correct - E-N-H-A-N-C-E. To enhance means to improve or increase the quality of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to search for information'?
explanation: Research is correct - R-E-S-E-A-R-C-H. Research means the systematic investigation to discover facts.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'full of bright colors'?
explanation: Vibrant is correct - V-I-B-R-A-N-T. Vibrant means bright and striking or full of energy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the result of something done'?
explanation: Consequence is correct - C-O-N-S-E-Q-U-E-N-C-E. A consequence is a result or effect of an action.
